english.title: Fail to comply with requirements of notice to chief officer of a shotgun transaction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to comply with section 42A(2) of the Firearms Act 1968 in that the notice of transaction sent by you to the chief officer of police for **(..SPECIFY CHIEF OFFICER..) under section 42A(1) of the Firearms Act 1968 did not

(A)_[contain a description of the shotgun]_
(B)_[state the nature of the transaction]_
(C)_[set out the particulars of any licence granted for the purposes of an order made under section 1 of the Import, Export and Customs Powers (Defence) Act 1939 by virtue of which the transaction was authorised under section 17 of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42A(3) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
